title: Load-path alignment in a single-level mesh
caption: Elongated pores rotated from across the load (alignment index A = −0.24, 8.6 N/m) through 30° and 60° to along the load (A = +0.35, 19.0 N/m): strength rises monotonically with the alignment of the material with the load, at constant mass. Screened REBO2, athermal quasi-static uniaxial tension along x; colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV); red rings: atoms that have lost a bond; frames between stored quasi-static states are interpolated. All statements are model results.
slow_motion: 3x within ±0.0025 strain of first damage, peak load and major propagation
